children.tooltip: Riposte +3: This item enchants its user with incredible awareness and speed, granting a +3 Insight bonus to AC and to Saves.
Insightful Combat Mastery +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.

Staggering Blow: This item is enchanted to make your attacks send enemies reeling. When you roll a 20 on an attack with a melee weapon you will knock the target down unless it makes a DC 17 Balance check.
Disable Device +16: Passive: +16 Competence bonus to the Disable Device skill.
Open Lock +16: Passive: +16 Competence bonus to the Open Lock skill.
